title: Canonical colimit cocone of restricted abelian cohomology
statement: Let X and X₀ be qcqs schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], i:X₀→X a morphism with inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], Λ a finite commutative ring, A a small filtered category of universe u+1, D:A→Sheaf(X_et,Mod Λ) a diagram of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and ι:D→const(F) a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each q≥0, apply module inverse image along i, forget to abelian sheaves, then apply the Ext cohomology functor Sheaf.functorH in degree q [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. The image of the supplied cocone is a colimit cocone of abelian groups, with vertex H^q(X₀,i⁻¹F) and legs H^q(i⁻¹ι_a). No representative is selected in this statement.

proof.text: Apply module inverse image to the supplied colimit cocone: upperStarLowerStarAdjunction makes this inverse image a left adjoint, so [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits] proves its image is colimiting. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-sheaves-forget-colimits] on X₀ to obtain a colimit cocone c of underlying abelian restrictions. This order avoids any compatibility comparison between module and abelian inverse images.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-category-exists-directed-final] (Mathlib IsFiltered.exists_directed) to choose a nonempty directed partial order I of universe u+1 and a final functor T:I→A. Mathlib Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv T c transports the colimit property of c to c.whisker T.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-directed-cohomology-colimit] to this directed abelian cocone, giving the colimit property after derived cohomology. Use the natural isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-sheafH-ext-derived-comparison] and Mathlib IsColimit.mapCoconeEquiv to transfer it to Sheaf.functorH.

The image under Sheaf.functorH of c.whisker T is definitionally the whiskering by T of the image of c. Mathlib Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv T (E.mapCocone c) reflects its colimit property to the original A-cocone. The iterated mapCocone is definitionally the cocone in the goal, including every leg.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03Q5 (lemma-colimit); U1 formal reduction: restrict modules first, forget coefficients using a proved left-adjoint argument, directed final reindexing, derived comparison, and final reflection.

theorem restrictedCohomology_isColimit
    {X X₀ : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace X₀] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀] (i : X₀ ⟶ X)
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory A] [IsFiltered A]
    {D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    {F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj F)
    (hc : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)))
    (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit
      (((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ] ⋙
        sheafCompose X₀.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⋙
        Sheaf.functorH X₀.smallEtaleTopology q).mapCocone (Cocone.mk F ι)))
